description:
About Our Brand and Products

Lehi Mills is a heritage baking brand rooted in quality, tradition, and performance. Based in Lehi, Utah, we’ve been milling flour and creating premium baking mixes for generations. Our products are trusted by home bakers and professionals alike, offering consistent results with simple, high-quality ingredients.

Our product lineup includes:

  • Premium bread and baking flours

  • Pancake & waffle mixes

  • Muffin mixes (including best-sellers like Raspberry, American Berry, and Carrot Cake)

  • Specialty and seasonal baking mixes

We exist to help bakers become the hero in their kitchen — with flour and mixes that elevate baking every time.

What Makes Us Different

1. Professional-Grade Quality
Our flour and mixes deliver consistent, bakery-level results. Many customers call it “the professional baker’s best kept secret.”

2. Heritage + Trust
We’re not a trendy startup — we’re a proven milling company with decades of credibility.

3. Better Performance, Not Just Marketing
Higher protein content, better structure, better texture. The difference shows in the rise, crumb, and flavor.

4. Versatile for Every Level
From first-time bakers to cottage bakers to high-volume kitchens — our products perform.

5. American Heritage Brand
We proudly produce quality baking staples that families can rely on.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Lehi Mills affiliates earn commission by promoting our products through unique tracking links.

  • Competitive commission rates on every sale

  • Cookie tracking to ensure you get credit

  • High AOV opportunities with multi-pack and bundle purchases

  • Seasonal promotions and limited-time offers that drive urgency

  • Strong repeat purchase behavior from loyal baking customers

With baking being both seasonal and evergreen (holidays, birthdays, Sunday dinners, sourdough trends, etc.), affiliates benefit from consistent year-round demand.

How to Promote Us

Affiliates can promote Lehi Mills in a variety of high-converting ways:

Content Ideas

  • Recipe blog posts featuring our mixes

  • “Pantry Staples” or “Baker Essentials” roundups

  • Holiday baking guides

  • Costco finds or grocery haul content

  • Comparison posts (why protein content in flour matters)

Social Media

  • Instagram reels showing before/after bakes

  • Pinterest recipe pins

  • TikTok baking videos

  • YouTube recipe tutorials

Email Marketing

  • Seasonal baking inspiration

  • Family baking traditions

  • Easy weeknight breakfast ideas

Performance Angles

  • “Pro-Level Results at Home”

  • “Flour That Makes You the Hero”

  • “Bursting with Flavor”

  • “Bakery Results Without the Guesswork”

We can also provide:

  • Product photography

  • Brand assets

  • Seasonal creative

  • Discount codes

  • Exclusive affiliate promotions

Other Information

  • U.S.-based brand with strong regional loyalty and growing national reach

  • Products are shelf-stable and easy to ship

  • Strong gifting and holiday potential

  • Family-friendly and wholesome positioning

  • Ideal for food bloggers, family influencers, homesteading creators, cottage bakers, and baking enthusiasts

Lehi Mills is more than flour — it’s the foundation for memorable moments in the kitchen.
